name: ds-surfaces
title: Choosing a surface
description: Where a task goes — in the page, over it, beside it, or instead of it — decided by what the reader is doing and how much there is. Dry-run against every overlay in the platform.

files.content:
import type { SurfaceId, SurfaceRuleId } from "@/lib/design-system/data";

export type Doing =
  | "Configuring"
  | "Creating"
  | "Picking"
  | "Reading"
  | "Confirming"
  | "Told it failed";

export type Today =
  | "Dialog"
  | "Alert dialog"
  | "Sheet"
  | "Popover"
  | "Command dialog"
  | "Browser confirm"
  | "Nothing"
  | "Inline"
  | "Page";

export type Verdict =
  | "keep"
  | "reshape"
  | "move"
  | "add-confirm"
  | "drop-confirm"
  | "add-undo";

export const VERDICT_LABEL: Record<Verdict, string> = {
  keep: "Keep",
  reshape: "Reshape",
  move: "Move",
  "add-confirm": "Add confirm",
  "drop-confirm": "Drop confirm",
  "add-undo": "Add undo",
};

  id: string;
  area: string;
  what: string;

  doing: Doing;
  today: Today;
  width?: string;
  should: SurfaceId;
